conclusion: In v2.23.2 a record is either serveable with valid_from collapsed onto the approval instant, or retroactive but proposed and invisible to recall. The two states are mutually exclusive, so the agent-facing path cannot establish the independent application-time axis Gen30 exists to test.

documented_admission_chain.note: authority manifest requires a registered agent
admission review requires an active enforce manifest for agent and workspace
admission source attestation refuses to sign without this key
record persists with the requested retroactive valid_from, but is not serveable
record becomes serveable and its valid_from is reset to the approval instant
re-ingesting restores the retroactive valid_from but returns the record to proposed

root_cause: models::Entity carries no valid_from_unix_ms/valid_to_unix_ms field. admission_decide clones the stored entity, flips status to active and re-persists it, so the application-time columns are rewritten to the write default.

system_identity.trust_class: agent-facing write under an enforce authority manifest, reviewed by a registered operator principal
